title: Higher-cohomology twist loss for finite near-projective modules
statement:
Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, and $g:Z\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], with $Z$ Noetherian (a finite affine cover has Noetherian coordinate rings) [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_Z$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] and $s:\mathcal L\to\mathcal O_Z$ an $\mathcal O_Z$-linear map whose image is the ideal $I\mathcal O_Z$ generated by the images of elements of $I$. Fix integers $d\geq1$ and $q\geq0$. Assume $H^j(Z,\mathcal E)=0$ for every coherent $\mathcal O_Z$-module $\mathcal E$ and every $j>d$, and $H^j(Z,\mathcal L^{\otimes v})=0$ for every $j>0$ and $v\geq q$ [pqf-def-coherent, pqf-def-cohomology]. Put $\mathcal F(v)=\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O_Z}\mathcal L^{\otimes v}$ for $v\geq0$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and for $v\geq e\geq0$ let $\delta_e:\mathcal F(v)\to\mathcal F(v-e)$ be induced by $s^{\otimes e}$. Let $c\geq0$ and let $M$ be a finite $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] such that for every $a\in I^c$ there exist $t_a\geq0$ and $A$-linear maps $M\to A^{\oplus t_a}\to M$ whose composite is $a\operatorname{id}_M$. Put $P(M)=g^*\widetilde M$ [def-pc-module-pullback, pqf-def-coherent]. Then $H^d(Z,P(M)(v))=0$ for every $v\geq q$. If $d\geq2$, also $H^{d-1}(Z,P(M)(v))=0$ for every $v\geq q$. For $1\leq i<d-1$ and $v\geq q+(d-1-i)c$, the map
$$H^i(\delta_{(d-1-i)c}):H^i(Z,P(M)(v))\longrightarrow H^i(Z,P(M)(v-(d-1-i)c))$$
is zero. The map $s$ need not be injective, and neither flatness of $g$ nor nilpotence of $I$ is assumed.

The decreasing-twist direction is induced by s:L to O, correcting the preceding source sentence.
